text:
mike.choi: CI helm-lint failing on chart 'inference-gpu-pools' when run in gitops pipeline. noticed it in staging deploy job — rendered manifest ballooned and cluster autoscaler tripped. logs below

mike.choi: ```
Error: values.schema.json: /gpuPools: expected array but found object
rendered manifests contain 200+ PodTemplates (map expansion loop?)
helm lint exit code 1
ci-job: https://ci.internal/redwood/inference-gpu-pools/1234
```

sasha.k: ugh, I pushed a helper last week that converts a named map into a list for downstream templating. works for most charts but probably hit a schema mismatch. can you paste the helper? @jamie-r any ideas? :thinking_face:

mike.choi: helper is `coerceMapToList` in _helpers.tpl — basically: `{{- if kindIs "map" . }}{{- range $k,$v := . }}{{- $v.name = $k }}{{- append $list $v }}{{- end }}{{- end }}`. it mutates and returns a list. used in deployment template as `{{- include "coerceMapToList" .Values.gpuPools }}`

jamie-r: pattern itself is fine, but values.schema expects `gpuPools` to be `array` with `items` {..}. If someone passes a map (legacy values), the linter will complain before the helper runs. Helm's JSON schema validation happens against raw values, not rendered output.

sasha.k: right. we switched to strict schema a week ago (`additionalProperties: false`) which is good, but broke charts that relied on maps-as-dicts. two options:
- update schema to allow `object` or `array` via `oneOf`/`anyOf`
- change upgrade docs and migration to require array shape

mike.choi: quick repro values that fails:
```yaml
# values.yaml (legacy)
gpuPools:
  small-gpu:
    gpuCount: 1
    nodeSelector:
      pool: small
  large-gpu:
    gpuCount: 4
    nodeSelector:
      pool: large
```

jamie-r: propose schema change: `oneOf: [{type: "array"}, {type: "object"}]` with deprecation note. helm lint will pass then, and helper can keep supporting maps. but we should emit a deprecation warning in chart template if object used.

sasha.k: agree. PR should include a small helper log: `{{- if kindIs "map" .Values.gpuPools }}{{- printf "WARNING: gpuPools map type deprecated, please migrate to array" | indent 0 }}{{- end }}`. maybe route to stdout only in `helm template`? not ideal but better than silent failures.

infra-ci-bot: CI failed: chart-testing/helm-lint (inference-gpu-pools) — https://ci.internal/ct/8765 — job artifacts saved

deploy-bot: opened branch `fix/gpuPools-schema-compat` with schema oneOf + deprecation banner: https://git.internal/redwood/charts/compare/fix/gpuPools-schema-compat — PTAL @sasha.k @jamie-r

sasha.k: looking now, will comment on deprecation wording. also add a small unit test in chart-tests to validate map -> list conversion so future changes catch this.

jamie-r: once merged, we should run a quick canary in staging to ensure autoscaler no longer sees exploded manifests. also add a note in migration guide.

mike.choi: thanks. I'll queue the canary after merge. :thumbsup:

sasha.k: nice catch by CI. saving us from a spiraling deploy in prod. :relieved:

mike.choi: closing ticket when branch merges.
